blocks.text: The Redaction page lets you add, view, and configure redaction profiles to enforce rights management for your organization. You can use redaction profiles as part of your SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy to hide sensitive content that triggers policy rules.

When configuring SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP policy rules, you can use the redaction profiles you create to add redaction characters to multiple file types. To learn more, see Adding & Editing Redaction Profiles.
The Redaction page provides the following benefits and allows you to:

blocks.item: Add, view, and configure redaction profiles for your organization.
Make redaction profiles available to be used on multiple file types as part of your SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP policy.

blocks.text: On the Redaction page (Data Security > DSPM > Rights Management > Redaction), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of all redaction profiles configured for your organization. For redaction profiles, you can see:
Profile Name: The name of the redaction profile. You can sort this column.
Redaction Type: The type of redaction used (asterisks or hash signs). You can sort this column.
Actions: Actions to edit or delete a redaction profile.
Modify the table and its columns.
